immutable_failure_reproduction.failed_component: source-ingest-agora-projector and deploy bounded source refresh readback gate
immutable_failure_reproduction.observed_failure: Agora projection does not bind the new receipt/run/source
immutable_failure_reproduction.root_cause: The one-shot Agora surface projector (scripts/project_market_data_to_bff_agora_surfaces.py) fetched raw source records from /api/source-ingest/source-records and only extracted the freshness dictionary from /api/source-ingest/controller/readback. Because the projector did not consume the full controller readback to bind the authoritative accepted ingest_run_id from latest_receipt and latest_source_record from the bounded refresh, records without explicit metadata run IDs fell back to None or stale IDs, and symbol selection did not prioritize the accepted receipt ingest run and source identity. Consequently, verify_bounded_source_refresh_readback in scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh failed when asserting row.connectorId == connector_id and row.ingestRunId == run_id and row.sourceId == source_id.

resolution_summary.projector_binding: Updated scripts/project_market_data_to_bff_agora_surfaces.py to consume the accepted receipt ingest_run_id and latest_source_record identity from the controller readback, emitting the record's authentic ingestRunId and sourceId without synthesizing provenance onto mismatched rows, and enforcing typed fail-closed rejection for missing record run (missing_record_run), run mismatch (mismatched_run), missing record source (missing_record_source), or source mismatch (mismatched_source).
resolution_summary.runtime_tiebreaker: Refactored services/source_ingestion/runtime.py::_latest_source_record_by_connector to remove hardcoded symbols, dynamically respect the active paper symbol contract from SOURCE_INGEST_ACTIVE_PAPER_SYMBOLS, and prioritize accepted receipt runs, primary price daily datasets, active symbols, and provider event time before creation time tie-breaks in the record ordering key.
resolution_summary.fail_closed_boundaries: Enforced fail-closed behavior with typed reasons for missing receipt (missing_refresh_receipt), unparsable receipt (unparsable_refresh_receipt), missing record run (missing_record_run), mismatched run (mismatched_run), missing record source (missing_record_source), mismatched source (mismatched_source), mismatched connector (mismatched_connector), non-official lineage (market_input_non_official_lineage), unverifiable calendar evidence (market_input_calendar_unverifiable), and future timestamps (future_timestamp).
resolution_summary.tests: Added deterministic tests in scripts/test_project_market_data_to_bff_agora_surfaces.py and services/source_ingestion/tests/test_runtime_latest_source_record.py covering exact typed failures, actual record ingestRunId and sourceId provenance without synthesis, missing record run rejection, same-run mismatched source ID rejection (mismatched_source), non-hardcoded priority symbols, accepted receipt run priority, price dataset priority, and newer provider event time priority over later created historical records.

fail_closed_boundaries: Stale weekday data without valid holiday evidence is rejected as market_input_stale / source_data_stale.
Missing, unparsable, or stale refresh receipt older than 24h is rejected as market_input_stale_refresh / source_data_stale.
Missing or tampered calendar evidence during exchange closure is rejected as market_input_calendar_unverifiable / source_data_stale.
Non-official lineage (source_id not starting with tw-official:) is rejected as market_input_non_official_lineage / source_data_stale.
Future event_time or observed_at is rejected as market_input_invalid / source_data_stale.
Readiness or refresh failure compensates to exact accepted read-only FE/BFF baseline with all writes false.
